title: audit-report-pilot
goal: Learn a formal expert workspace from asset valuation working papers and reference audit opinions, so that a blank agent can later generate a qualified internal audit opinion document (内部审核意见) that matches professional human reviewer standards.

targetPaths.label: learned expert workspace for audit opinion generation

validators.title: Learned expert workspace layout is valid
Blank-agent deployment: generate audit opinion using only the expert workspace

initialGraph.planner_summary: Read the source valuation materials (定稿 + 电子底稿) to understand the project scope, then synthesize a formal expert workspace that teaches a blank agent how to generate a professional internal audit opinion document covering all 6 review dimensions.

units.title: Inspect Source Materials
units.goal: Thoroughly read the valuation deliverables (定稿) and working papers (电子底稿). Extract the valuation scope, methodology, key assumptions, critical data, risk areas, and conclusion structure. Understand what a professional audit opinion must cover.
units.claim: Source materials have been thoroughly analyzed and key audit opinion requirements have been extracted.
units.check_plan: Leave structured analysis notes in workspace that the synthesis unit can use.

units.title: Synthesize Expert Workspace
units.goal: Write a formal expert workspace that teaches a blank agent how to produce a qualified internal audit opinion. The workspace must include: (1) manifest.md with expert rules covering all 6 review dimensions, (2) change_log.md tracking iterations, (3) output_contract.md defining the expected output format and quality standards. The workspace should teach HOW to derive findings from materials — never bake in final answers.
units.claim: The expert workspace is complete enough to guide a blank agent through producing a professional audit opinion.
units.check_plan: Update the tracked expert workspace with stable rules, output contract, and execution guidance. The blank agent must be able to follow it without seeing the original materials.

notes: Campaign mode following the campaign-smoke pattern. Worker agents learn an expert workspace from source materials. Campaign harvest/lead/reviewer roles accumulate knowledge across rounds. A blank-agent deployment acceptance test validates that the expert workspace actually teaches a blank agent to produce a qualified audit opinion. Soft validation compares the blank agent's output against the human reference audit opinion.
